query: Migrate our legacy provider system to PNM.
expected_behavior: Enters Migration mode and runs full discovery on both the legacy and target sides
Defines an identifier strategy covering legacy numbers, NPI gaps and tax IDs, with external identifiers for idempotent loads
Maps legacy entities to product objects by anchor and gives a dependency-ordered load sequence
Covers cleansing (missing NPI on part of the population), parity checks, a shadow run, cutover and rollback
Covers each downstream consumer with a bridge or cutover plan, including the capitation payment process
Addresses change management and history migration scope
Decomposes into migration-lane stories, at most ten per epic, each with Pattern E
must_not: Assume history must be migrated in full without asking
